description: One Lamoi site (serviceId from oma_waas_sites). get (default) shows the address, state, plan, pages, the homepage page id (front; 0 means the posts list), the 7-day security summary and plan (what the site uses against its plan: tier, limits and usage for pages, posts, products, users = people who can edit, diskMb, plus media count; full and over list the kinds at or past the limit; renews; null when the site cannot say). Over the plan nothing is removed; only new items are stopped, and the owner upgrades on the site page billing tab. Page text changes go through oma_waas_page, not the WordPress hosting tools. login (confirm) makes a one-time link (2 minutes) into the editor; optional to = an editor path such as /wp-admin/post-new.php?post_type=page.

op.description: get is default; login (confirm) makes a one-time editor sign-in link.

serviceId.description: The Lamoi site's service id (from oma_waas_sites).

to.description: login: editor path to open, e.g. /wp-admin/post-new.php?post_type=page.
